VAL-BOOK-026.observed: Created guest gst_4cc4266f-d0c0-4461-b456-72970bd7e132 via a phone booking on 2026-10-24 (owned date) with guest.allergyNotes and reservation dietaryNotes = 'contract-sensitive-book026'. VAL-BOOK-028.observed: App resource route with a kody operator session cookie (obtained by curl POST /login -> 302 + en_session cookie; value never printed): GET http://localhost:3001/resources/reservations/region-summary?orgSlug=acme -> HTTP 200, cache-control: private, no-store, body {"summary":{counts},"known":true,"requiresConfirmation":true}. Tenant-api internal route: POST http://localhost:3007/internal/reservations/summary with no token -> 401 {"error":"unauthorized"}; wrong token -> 401; valid INTERNAL_COMMAND_TOKEN -> 200 with counts only. Both bodies match the tenant DB exactly: reservations 27, guests 28 (erased_at IS NULL), tables 19 (archived_at IS NULL), activeWaitlist 2, auditEntries 74, upcomingReservations 18. Neither body contains any guest name, phone, email or note text (checked my g11 values plus 93 field values from 40 real guest rows: 0 hits). Unauthenticated App call: document -> HTTP 302 redirect to /login?redirectTo=..., .data XHR -> HTTP 202 SingleFetchRedirect to /login, no data.
VAL-BOOK-028.notes: Deviation from the literal '401/403' for unauthenticated calls: the internal route returns 401, but the App resource route refuses by redirecting to /login (302 for a document request, 202 SingleFetchRedirect for a .data XHR). That is the repo-standard requireUserId behavior and is identical to the sibling staffing.region-summary route; no data or PII is returned. Flagged for the parent rather than silently treated as 401/403.

VAL-BOOK-033.observed: Against GET /operator/reservations/book/day, POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations and POST /operator/reservations/book/walk-ins on 3007 (Idempotency-Key supplied so auth failures are unambiguous): (1) no Authorization header -> 401 {"error":"Missing bearer token"} on all three; (2) JWT signed with the wrong secret -> 401 Invalid or expired on all three; (3) expired token -> 401 on all three; (4) token with exp-iat=3600 (>900) -> 401 Malformed reservations operator token claims on all three; (5) reports-scope token (no reservation grant) -> 403 {"error":"invalid_scope","expected":["book"],"actual":"reports"} on all three; (6) riyadh-grill (ksa) token against US node 3007 -> 403 {"error":"region_mismatch"} with no data, and an acme token against KSA node 3009 -> 403 region_mismatch. Positive control: valid acme book token GET /day -> 200. The negative matrix created no rows (checked the tenant DB for the probe names: 0).
VAL-BOOK-033.notes: The server verifies JWTs with clockTolerance 5s (apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-auth.ts:84), so a --ttl 1 token still passes ~2s after mint; the 401 appears only after sleeping past the tolerance (used 8s). Documented for future validators. Case (4) fails as 'Malformed ... claims' because the claims schema validates the TTL bound, still 401 as required.
